title: GSA-Acquisition-FAR (official FAR XML/DITA, through FAC 2025-06 of 2025-10-01)
supports: Opened via git clone 2026-11-01 (last commit 2026-03-30). grep of all 3,945 FAR DITA files found NO text implementing FY2023 NDAA Sec. 5949 (no 'covered semiconductor', CXMT, YMTC or SMIC): Sec. 5949 not yet in the FAR as of FAC 2025-06

title: FAR 4.2101 Definitions (Section 889 covered telecom)
supports: Opened: 'Reasonable inquiry means an inquiry designed to uncover any information in the entity's possession ... that excludes the need to include an internal or third-party audit' - the Sec. 889 precedent a Sec. 5949 rule would likely copy

title: FAR 40.202 / 52.240-1 American Security Drone Act prohibition (Nov 2024)
supports: Opened: FAR Part 40 (supply-chain security) is where recent covered-foreign-entity bans land, implemented by a single clause (52.240-1) - precedent for a Sec. 5949 clause

title: FAR 52.211-5 Material Requirements
supports: Opened: 'New means composed of previously unused components'; used/reconditioned supplies need contracting-officer acceptance - limits recovered/recert DRAM in federal supply contracts

title: FAR 52.246-26 Reporting Nonconforming Items (Aug 2024)
supports: Opened: 'Counterfeit item' includes 'used items represented as new, or the false identification of grade, serial number, lot number, date code, or performance characteristics'

title: FAR 25.001 General (Buy American)
supports: Opened: the Buy American domestic content test 'has been waived for acquisition of commercially available off-the-shelf (COTS) items'

title: FAR 25.101 General (domestic end product)
supports: Opened: domestic components must exceed 60% of component cost, 65% for items delivered 2024-2028 and 75% from 2029

title: FAR 25.106 Determining reasonableness of cost
supports: Opened: civilian BAA evaluation adds 20% to the low foreign offer if the low domestic offer is from a large business, 30% if from a small business

title: FAR 25.402 Trade Agreements thresholds
supports: Opened: WTO GPA threshold $174,000 for supply and service contracts - above it, TAA designated-country products (Korea, Taiwan, Japan) compete equally with U.S.-made

title: FAR 16.203-1 Fixed-price contracts with economic price adjustment - Description
supports: Opened: EPA may be based on established prices, actual costs, or 'cost indexes of labor or material ... specifically identified in the contract' - federal contracts already accept index-based material escalation (E-02)

title: FAR 52.216-4 Economic Price Adjustment - Labor and Material (Jan 2017)
supports: Opened: standard FAR clause for labor/material price adjustment exists (E-02)

title: DFARS 252.246-7008 Sources of Electronic Parts (JAN 2023)
